title: Straight to Market
description:
The **Deposit Upgrade** empties your backpack into any inventory you sneak-right-click.

Point it at a **selling bin** and a full day's harvest goes in with one click. Filter it so only the things you mean to sell go across.

Pair it with a hopper feeding the bin and auto-sell switched on, and the farm runs itself while you're off breeding something better.

*The Restock Upgrade is the same idea in reverse — pull seeds out of a chest without opening it.*
